fusions.name: Drowning Tangle
fusions.desc: Hurls a sodden mass of strands that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and has a 50% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Strand Spray
fusions.desc: Whips a fan of wet strands 4 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to everything in it. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Kelp Curtain
fusions.desc: Hangs a curtain of dripping strands 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Knotting Current
fusions.desc: Every hit you land knots a stack onto that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
